description.en: Paratingia-inspired small monocaulous tree. Each compound-leaf rachis carries two larger adaxial pinnule rows and two smaller abaxial rows; crown leaf number is artistic. No fern flowers or cones added.
description.zh: Paratingia启发单干小树，每条复叶轴有上侧两列较大小叶、下侧两列较小小叶；冠叶数量属美术选择。不添加现代蕨花或球果。

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.
artistic_choices.zh: 名义尺度、原创配色、重复结构数量及静态姿态属美术选择。不作严格种级复原、标本复制、运动机制、动画或共存复原承诺。

structural_scope.en: Four rows on each compound rachis: larger adaxial pair and smaller abaxial pair. Crown leaf number is artistic, not the definition of four rows. Terrestrial small single-stem tree concept.
structural_scope.zh: 每条复叶轴上四列：上侧两列较大、下侧两列较小；冠叶数量属美术选择，不能替代四列结构。陆生单干小树概念。
